item.title: Lee Kwang-jae: "If the 'Legitimate Child' Debate Continues, We'll Have Deficit Politics" (이광재 “적자(嫡子) 논쟁 계속하면 적자(赤字) 정치 된다”)
item.description:
Lee Kwang-jae: "If the 'Legitimate Child' Debate Continues, We'll Have Deficit Politics" (이광재 “적자(嫡子) 논쟁 계속하면 적자(赤字) 정치 된다”)

Lee Kwang-jae, a lawmaker from the Democratic Party of Korea, stated on the 8th regarding the "legitimate child" controversy that has emerged during the party leadership election: "If we keep up the 'legitimate child' debate, it will result in deficit politics." (이광재 더불어민주당 의원은 8일 당대표 선거 과정에서 불거진 ‘적자(嫡子)’ 논쟁을 두고 “적자(嫡子) 논쟁을 계속하면 적자(赤字) 정치가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

Appearing on a radio program that day, the lawmaker said, "While we can fiercely debate our party's direction, it's not good to descend into emotional strife." He added, "Instead of criticizing opponents, candidates who compliment them will likely receive more votes from Democratic Party members." (이 의원은 이날 한 라디오에 출연해 “노선 싸움은 치열하게 해도 지만 감정싸움으로 가는 것은 좋지 않다”고 했다. 이어 “상대를 비난하기보다 칭찬하는 후보가 민주당 당원들에게 더 많은 표를 받을 것”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the recent "Pro-Roh, Pro-Moon orthodox line" controversy raised during the party leadership race, he stated, "You can't speak of President Roh Moo-hyun without President Kim Dae-jung, and you can't speak of the Democratic Party without President Roh Moo-hyun." (최근 당권 경쟁 과정에서 제기된 ‘친노·친문 적통’ 논란에 대해서는 “김대중 대통령 없이 노무현 대통령을 말할 수 없고, 노무현 대통령 없이 민주당을 말할 수 없다”고 했다.)

He remarked, "If you intend to carry on that spirit, you need to clearly state what you will carry forward. Offering alternatives is what makes a true 'legitimate child.'" (그는 “그 정신을 이어가겠다면 무엇을 이어갈 것인지를 명료하게 말해야 한다”며 “대안을 내야 진정한 적자(嫡子)”라고 했다.)

The lawmaker also proposed a reorganization of the party's leadership system. He suggested, "Let's assign the two appointed Supreme Council seats to metropolitan and basic local government heads." He added, "This way, the party leader won't be able to move the party at will. Since these local leaders have received both approval from party members and the public, their voices should be brought into the party." (이 의원은 당 지도체제 개편 방안도 제안했다. 그는 “지명직 최고위원 2석을 광역단체장과 기초단체장에게 맡기자”고 했다. 이어 “그래야 당대표가 당을 마음대로 움직이지 못한다”며 “광역단체장과 기초단체장은 당원의 선택과 국민의 선택을 모두 받은 분들인 만큼 그 목소리가 당에 들어와야 한다”고 했다.)

He argued, "This is how the Democratic Party can transform into a policy-oriented party and take on the image of a nationwide party." (그는 “그렇게 해야 민주당이 정책 정당으로 바뀔 수 있고, 전국 정당의 모습을 갖출 수 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding former representative Jung Cheong-rae's management of the party over the past year, he commented, "There were notable aspects in areas like prosecution reform." However, he added, "President Lee Jae-myung tried to deliver many economic messages, but that part was somewhat lacking. Overall, it was passable." (정청래 전 대표의 지난 1년 당 운영에 대해서는 “검찰개혁 등에서는 선명한 부분이 있었다”고 했다. 다만 “이재명 대통령은 경제 메시지를 많이 내려고 했는데 그 부분은 다소 부족했다”며 “전반적으로는 무난했다”고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on 32nd Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Death, "Wishing Eternal Life to the Great Leader" (김정은, 김일성 32주기 금수산태양궁전 참배… “위대한 수령님 영생 축원”)
item.description:
Kim Jong Un Visits Kumsusan Palace of the Sun on 32nd Anniversary of Kim Il Sung's Death, "Wishing Eternal Life to the Great Leader" (김정은, 김일성 32주기 금수산태양궁전 참배… “위대한 수령님 영생 축원”)

North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun, where the bodies of Kim Il Sung and Kim Jong Il are preserved, on the 32nd anniversary of Chairman Kim Il Sung's death on the 8th. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 김일성 주석 사망 32주기인 8일 김일성·김정일 시신이 보존돼 있는 금수산태양궁전을 참배했다.)

North Korea's Korean Central News Agency reported that Kim Jong Un visited the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun in Pyongyang at midnight on that day. (북한 조선중앙통신은 김정은이 이날 0시 평양의 금수산태양궁전을 찾았다고 보도했다.)

The agency stated, "Participants included members of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea, leading party and government officials, workers of the Party Central Committee, the Standing Committee of the Supreme People's Assembly, the Cabinet, committees, ministry officials, and command members of military organs." (통신은 “조선노동당 중앙위원회 정치국 상무위원회 위원들을 비롯한 당과 정부의 지도 간부들과 당 중앙위원회 일꾼들, 최고인민회의 상임위원회, 내각, 위원회, 성 책임 일꾼들, 무력 기관의 지휘 성원들이 참가했다”고 전했다.)

The agency reported, "Comrade Kim Jong Un, along with the participants, paid noble respects to the statues of the great leader and the great general. Comrade Kim Jong Un then visited the halls of eternal life and paid solemn respects, wishing eternal life to the great leader and the great general." (통신은 “김정은 동지께서는 참가자들과 함께 위대한 수령님과 위대한 장군님의 입상을 우러러 숭고한 경의를 표시하셨다”고 했다. 이어 “김정은 동지께서는 영생홀들을 찾으시어 위대한 수령님과 위대한 장군님께 영생 축원의 인사를 삼가 드리셨다”고 했다.)

The agency described the anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death as "the greatest day of remembrance for our party, state, and people" and claimed, "All people of the country and People's Army soldiers are filled with boundless longing and reverence for the rare great sage who made 'changing the world, enriching the country and strengthening the military' his lifelong motto, elevated our party and state into a true people's party and a genuine people's country, and laid the eternal foundation of our style of socialism, advancing triumphantly through independence, self-reliance, and self-defense." (통신은 김일성 사망일에 대해 “우리 당과 국가, 인민의 최대의 추모의 날”이라며 “온 나라 전체 인민과 인민군 장병은 이민위천, 부국강병을 필생의 좌우명으로 삼으시고 우리 당과 국가를 참다운 인민의 당, 진정한 인민의 나라로 일떠세우셨으며 자주, 자립, 자위로 승승장구하는 우리식 사회주의의 만년 기틀을 다져주신 희세의 대성인에 대한 다함없는 그리움과 경모심에 넘쳐 있다”고 주장했다.)

North Korean media often report Kim Jong Un's activities the day after an event, but news of this visit was reported on the same day. (북한 매체들은 김정은의 동정을 행사 다음 날 전하는 경우가 많지만, 이날 참배 소식은 당일에 보도했다.)

This year's anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death does not fall on a significant 5- or 10-year cycle that North Korea emphasizes, so large-scale commemorative events with Kim Jong Un's attendance are not expected to occur. (올해 김일성 사망일은 북한이 중시하는 5년, 10년 단위 주기가 아니어서, 김정은이 참석하는 대규모 기념 행사는 열리지 않을 것으로 보인다.)

Kim Jong Un attended a central memorial meeting held at Pyongyang's Kim Il Sung Square in 2024, the 30th anniversary of Kim Il Sung's death, following his visit to the Kumsusan Palace of the Sun. (김정은은 김일성 30주기인 2024년에는 금수산태양궁전 참배에 이어 평양 김일성광장에서 열린 중앙 추모 대회에도 참석했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "The Fatherland Innovation Party's National Convention Must Not Become an Election to Choose My Proxy" (조국 “조국혁신당 전당대회, 내 대리인 뽑는 선거 되면 안 돼”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk: "The Fatherland Innovation Party's National Convention Must Not Become an Election to Choose My Proxy" (조국 “조국혁신당 전당대회, 내 대리인 뽑는 선거 되면 안 돼”)

After losing the National Assembly by-election, former leader Cho Kuk, who stepped down as party leader of the Fatherland Innovation Party, stated that the national convention should not become an election to select a 'proxy for Cho Kuk.' (국회의원 재·보궐선거 낙선 이후 조국혁신당 당대표직에서 물러난 조국 전 대표가 전당대회가 ‘조국 대리인’을 뽑는 선거가 돼서는 안 된다고 말했다.)

Former leader Cho made this statement in a post addressed to party members on Facebook on the morning of the 8th. (조 전 대표는 8일 아침 페이스북에 당원들에게 보내는 글을 올려 이같이 말했다.)

"By no means should this national convention be seen or allowed to unfold as an election to pick 'Cho Kuk's proxy or spokesperson,' or an election to 'defend Cho Kuk,'" former leader Cho said. "I hope such words do not emerge during the convention process." (조 전 대표는 “이번 전당대회는 결코 ‘조국의 대리인·대변인’을 뽑는 선거, 또는 ‘조국 지키기’ 선거로 비춰져서도, 그렇게 흘러가서도 안 된다”며 “전대 과정에서 이런 류의 단어가 나오지 않길 바란다”고 했다.)

He added, "Please establish a leadership that can newly define the vision, values, and policies of the Fatherland Innovation Party, and dedicate itself to winning the 2028 general election and creating the 5th democratic government." He also urged, "Create a leadership with a humble mindset and attitude that can gather all the party's capabilities, a leadership that fosters harmony and integration." (그러면서 “조국혁신당의 비전, 가치, 정책을 새롭게 정립하고, 2028년 총선 승리와 제5기 민주 정부 창출을 위해 헌신할 수 있는 지도부를 세워 달라”고 했다. 또 “겸허한 마음과 자세를 갖춰 당의 모든 역량을 모을 수 있는 지도부, 화합과 융화를 이끌어내는 지도부를 만들어 달라”고 했다.)

Regarding himself, he said, "As a sovereign party member, I will fulfill my responsibilities and once again pave a 'pathless path.'" (본인은 “한 명의 주권당원으로서 저의 책임을 다하면서 다시 한번 ‘길 없는 길’을 개척해나갈 것”이라고 했다.)

Former leader Cho diagnosed, "Since the election in June, the political landscape, which had a firm Democratic Party advantage, has rapidly shifted into a tight battle between camps." Referring to the divisions within the Democratic Party of Korea, he said, "The use of derogatory terms and divisive tactics have caused fractures within the democratic progressive camp," adding, "Vision and value-centered coalition politics have been sidelined, and the era's tasks of resolving polarization and inequality are not at the center of politics." He further stated, "The support base of the democratic progressive camp is shrinking, and warning lights have turned on for the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election." (조 전 대표는 “지난 6월 선거 이후, 확고한 민주당 우위의 정치 구도가 진영 간 박빙 대결 구도로 급변했다”고 진단했다. 그는 더불어민주당 내 분열에 대해 “멸칭까지 동원하는 갈라치기로 인해 민주진보 진영 내부에 파열이 발생했다”며 “비전과 가치 중심의 연합 정치는 뒷전이 됐고, 양극화와 불평등 해소라는 시대적 과제는 정치의 중심이 되지 못하고 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “민주진보 진영의 지지 기반이 축소되고 있고, 2028년 총선과 2030년 대선에 경고등이 켜졌다”고 했다.)

Former leader Cho emphasized, "This national convention must become a turning point that delivers a meaningful shock not just to the Fatherland Innovation Party but to the entire democratic progressive camp." He added, "We must lay the stepping stones to become a party that suggests a path of 'unwavering reform and solid enhancement of people's livelihoods' in South Korea after the insurrection." (조 전 대표는 “이번 전당대회는 조국혁신당을 넘어 민주진보 진영 전체에 의미 있는 충격을 주는 전환점이 돼야 한다”고 강조했다. 그러면서 “내란 이후 대한민국에서 ‘거침없는 개혁, 확실한 민생 강화’의 길을 제시하는 정당이 되기 위한 디딤돌을 놓아야 한다”고 했다.)

For the upcoming Fatherland Innovation Party national convention next month, lawmaker Shin Jang-sik has announced his candidacy for party leader. Candidates for the Supreme Council member positions include Hwang Hyun-sun, former senior administrative officer at the Moon Jae-in administration's Blue House; lawmaker Cha Kyu-geun; and Lee Suk-yoon, deputy chair of the party's policy committee. In his declaration of candidacy, lawmaker Shin did not mention former leader Cho but stated that he would carry forward the legacies of former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan and the late former Progressive Justice Party leader Noh Hoe-chan. <<>> (다음 달 치러지는 조국혁신당 전당대회에는 당대표 후보로 신장식 의원이 출마했다. 최고위원 후보로는 황현선 전 문재인 정부 청와대 선임행정관, 차규근 의원, 이숙윤 당 정책위원회 부의장이 출마했다. 신 의원은 출마 선언에서 조 전 대표를 언급하지 않은 채 이해찬 전 국무총리와 노회찬 전 진보정의당 대표를 계승하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: Han Dong-hoon Criticizes Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Will the Democratic Party Side with Murderers?" (한동훈, 보완수사권 폐지 비판... “민주당, 살인자 편에 설 거냐”)
item.description:
Han Dong-hoon Criticizes Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers... "Will the Democratic Party Side with Murderers?" (한동훈, 보완수사권 폐지 비판... “민주당, 살인자 편에 설 거냐”)

As the Democratic Party of Korea convened a full session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 8th to propose a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act that completely abolishes the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized the push to eliminate such powers, asking, "Will the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party side with murderers?" (더불어민주당이 8일 국회 법제사법위원회 전체회의를 열어 검찰 보완 수사권 완전 폐지를 주 내용으로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 상정하는 가운데, 한동훈 무소속 의원이 “이재명 정권과 더불어민주당은 살인자의 편에 설 것인가”라며 보완 수사권 폐지 추진을 비판했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, Han stated, "The public is outraged by the evidence tampering carried out by the father of Jang Yun-gi, a high school girl's murderer, who is a current police officer." He added, "It has been revealed that even the head of the police investigation team actively participated in tampering with evidence for 'the son of a police officer friend.'" (한 의원은 이날 아침 페이스북에 글을 올려 “여고생 살해범 장윤기 아버지가 현직 경찰 신분으로 벌인 증거 인멸에 국민들께서 공분하고 계신다”며 “경찰 수사팀장까지 ‘친구인 경찰 간부의 아들’을 위한 증거 인멸에 적극 가담했음이 드러나고 있다”고 했다.)

He continued, "Without the prosecution's supplementary investigation, the evidence tampering by the perpetrator's father, a current police officer, and his police officer friend would have been buried forever." He argued, "The Jang Yun-gi case clearly shows that if only the police are allowed to conduct investigations, countless innocent victims could arise." (이어 “검찰의 보완 수사가 없었다면 현직 경찰인 범인 아버지와 그 친구 경찰 간부가 벌인 증거 인멸은 영영 묻혔을 것”이라며 “장윤기 사건은 오직 경찰만이 수사를 할 수 있게 되면 억울한 피해자가 수없이 생겨날 수 있다는 점을 극명하게 보여준다”고 했다.)

Han criticized, "Nevertheless, the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party, obsessed only with the party convention, are determined to eliminate even the supplementary investigation powers." Referring to former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok's announcement last month that "the abolition of supplementary investigation powers has been finalized as the government's basic stance," Han said, "Not content with having already stated the government's position on abolishing supplementary investigation powers, the Democratic Party yesterday again declared that the abolition is 'firm and unwavering.'" (한 의원은 “그런데도 전당대회에만 정신이 팔린 이재명 정권과 민주당은 보완 수사권마저 기어이 없애겠다고 한다”고 비판했다. 그는 민주당 당대표 선거 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리가 지난달 “보완 수사권 폐지를 정부의 기본 입장으로 최종 정리했다”고 발표한 것을 거론하면서 “이미 정부 입장을 보완 수사권 폐지라고 한 것도 모자라서, 어제 민주당은 또 다시 ‘보완 수사권 폐지는 확고부동’하다고 했다”고 했다.)

Han noted, "The Democratic Party, which went wild over the prosecution's alleged 'fabricated indictment' using Lee Hwa-young's 'salmon drinking party' lie as a pretext, remains silent on the police's 'real fabrication.'" He predicted, "If this continues, after October 2 (when the prosecution office and supplementary investigation powers are abolished and the Public Prosecution Service is launched), cases like Jang Yun-gi's will occur in droves." (한 의원은 “이화영씨의 ‘연어 술 파티’ 거짓말을 빌미로 검찰의 ‘조작 기소’ 운운하며 길길이 날뛰던 민주당은, 경찰의 ‘진짜 조작’에는 침묵한다”며 “이대로라면 (검찰청과 보완 수사권이 폐지되고 공소청이 출범하는) 10월 2일 이후, 장윤기 사건들이 속출할 것”이라고 내다봤다.)

Han also said, "Normally, one fixes the barn after losing a cow, but the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party are instead trying to completely and thoroughly eliminate the barn after losing the cow." He added, "If this is their stance even after seeing the Jang Yun-gi case, the Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party have effectively declared that it's okay for countless Jang Yun-gi cases to happen in South Korea in the future, and for people to never know how the police botched or covered up the cases." (한 의원은 “보통은 소 잃고 외양간을 고치는데, 이재명 정권과 민주당은 오히려 소 잃고 외양간을 더 완전히, 철저히 없애겠다고 한다”고도 했다. 한 의원은 그러면서 “장윤기 사건을 보고도 이런 식이라면, 이재명 정권과 민주당은 앞으로 대한민국에서 수많은 장윤기 사건이 일어나고 어떻게 경찰이 사건을 뭉개거나 덮었는지 모르고 넘어가는 나라가 돼도 상관없다고 선언한 것”이라고 했다.)

Han concluded, "South Korea's long-built social safety net is on the verge of collapsing entirely," and asked, "The Lee Jae-myung regime and the Democratic Party, who think winning the party convention is all that matters and have no regard for the lives of ordinary citizens afterward, I ask you: Will you insist on siding with murderers?" (한 의원은 “대한민국이 오랫동안 쌓아 올린 사회 안전이 송두리째 무너지기 일보 직전”이라며 “전당대회만 이기면 장땡이고 그 후 평범한 국민의 삶은 어떻게 되든 안중에도 없는 이재명 정권과 민주당에 묻는다. 기어이 살인자의 편에 설 것이냐”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Min-seok Takes Another Direct Aim at Chung Cheong-rae: "Overzealousness Ruined the Merger with the Innovation Party" (김민석, 정청래 또 직격…“과욕에 혁신당과 합당 그르쳐”)
item.description:
Kim Min-seok Takes Another Direct Aim at Chung Cheong-rae: "Overzealousness Ruined the Merger with the Innovation Party" (김민석, 정청래 또 직격…“과욕에 혁신당과 합당 그르쳐” )

Kim Min-seok, a former Prime Minister who has declared his candidacy for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel on the 8th to clarify suspicions regarding his absence from the vote to lift martial law on December 3rd. (더불어민주당 대표 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리가 8일 김어준씨 유튜브에 출연해 12·3 계엄 당일 계엄 해제 투표 불참에 대한 의혹을 해명했다.)

On that day, Kim Eo-joon released CCTV footage showing the situation at the National Assembly on the day of the martial law declaration, during his show "Humility is Hard. News Factory." Kim explained, "As far as we know, he didn't just keep sleeping after taking cold medicine; he woke up late, was already inside the National Assembly by climbing over the wall by the time of the vote, and missed it by a narrow margin." (김어준씨는 이날 자신이 진행하는 ‘겸손은 힘들다. 뉴스공장’에서 계엄 당일 국회 상황을 녹화한 CCTV 영상을 공개했다. 그러면서 김씨는 “저희가 알기로는 감기약 먹고 계속 잔 게 아니라 뒤늦게 일어났고, 표결 시점에는 이미 국회 담을 넘어 국회 안에 있었고, 간발의 차이로 놓쳤다”며 설명했다.)

In response, former Prime Minister Kim stated, "I was one second late (to the vote)," adding, "The moment I sat down, Lee Jae-myung, who was then the party leader next to me, said, 'I just pressed (the button).'" (그러자 김 전 총리도 “(표결에) 1초 늦었다”며 “(본회의장에) 딱 앉는 순간 제 옆자리에 계시던 이재명, 당시 대표께서 ‘막 눌렀다’고 했다”고 했다.)

Regarding the merger with the Fatherland Innovation Party, former Prime Minister Kim said, "That's something the Innovation Party must decide," and added, "When forces of a similar nature unite with the Democratic Party, a large responsible party, it's always through absorption mergers." (조국혁신당과의 합당 문제에 대해 김 전 총리는 “그건 혁신당이 결정해야 한다”며 “거대 책임 정당인 민주당으로 성격이 같은 세력들이 결합할 때는 다 흡수 합당한다”고 했다.)

Criticizing former Representative Chung's approach to pushing the merger, he pointed out, "He ruined it by making a surprise announcement," adding, "It was overzealous. (As a result) I think things got tangled up." (정 전 대표의 합당 추진 방식에 대해서는 “폭탄선언식으로 해서 일을 그르쳤다”며 “과욕이었다. (그래서) 일이 꼬였다고 본다”고 지적했다.)

In response to former Representative Chung Cheong-rae's criticism that "the party leadership being a romantic aspiration is just him playing politics," former Prime Minister Kim said, "If that's the only example you can point to, then I'm grateful for the evaluation that I've hardly engaged in self-serving politics." (김 전 총리는 정청래 전 대표가 ‘당 대표가 로망이라고 한 게 자기 정치’라며 자신을 비판한 데 대해선 “그것이 지적할 수 있는 유일한 사례라면 저는 자기 정치를 거의 안 했다고 평가해주신 것이어서 감사하다”고 했다.)

Former Prime Minister Kim also revealed that he once recommended writer Yoo Si-min, who has recently been clashing with him, for the position of Prime Minister. Kim said, "I never once considered becoming Prime Minister myself," adding, "When someone asked, 'Have you ever recommended writer Yoo Si-min (as Prime Minister)?' I replied, 'That's correct.'" (김 전 총리는 최근 자신에 대해 대립각을 세우고 있는 유시민 작가를 총리로 추천한 적이 있다는 점도 밝혔다. 김 전 총리는 “원래 총리를 하려고 생각한 적이 한 번도 없다”며 “누가 ‘혹시 유시민 작가를 (총리로) 추천한 적이 있느냐’고 하셔서 ‘맞습니다’라고 말씀드렸던 적도 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the 2016 general election under the Kim Jong-in emergency committee system, where former Prime Minister Lee Hae-chan, former Representative Chung Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Kim Hyun were cut off, he said, "I was so angry that I went to the National Assembly and met with lawmaker Kim Hyun," adding, "I once publicly said that it would be good for former Representative Chung to become party leader at some point." (또 ‘김종인 비상대책위’ 체제로 총선을 치른 2016년 이해찬 전 총리, 정청래 전 대표, 김현 의원 등이 컷오프된 점에 “너무 화가 나서 국회 앞으로 찾아가서 김현 의원을 만난 적이 있다”며 “언젠가는 정 전 대표가 한 번 당 대표를 하는 게 좋겠다는 이야길 공개적으로 한 적도 있다”고 했다.)

However, he added, "But aside from that, since he (former Representative Chung) has already held the (leadership) position once..." (그러면서도 “그런데 그것과 달리 (정 전 대표는) 한번 (대표직을) 하셨으니까”라고 덧붙였다.)

item.title: U.S. Embassy in Seoul: "Ambassador Steel to Arrive in Seoul Soon... Expectation of Strengthened Relations" (주한 美대사관 “스틸 대사 곧 서울 부임... 관계 강화 기대”)
item.description:
U.S. Embassy in Seoul: "Ambassador Steel to Arrive in Seoul Soon... Expectation of Strengthened Relations" (주한 美대사관 “스틸 대사 곧 서울 부임... 관계 강화 기대”)

The U.S. Embassy in Seoul stated on X (formerly Twitter) on the 8th, "Introducing Michelle Steel, the new U.S. Ambassador to South Korea," adding, "Ambassador Steel will soon arrive in Seoul, and we look forward to further strengthening the relationship between the two countries." (주한 미국 대사관은 8일 X(옛 트위터)에 “미셸 스틸 신임 주한 미국 대사를 소개한다”며 “스틸 대사는 곧 서울에 부임할 예정이며, 양국의 관계를 더욱 강화해 나가기를 기대하고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

In the accompanying video, Ambassador Steel alternated between English and Korean, saying, "It is a great honor to be appointed as the next U.S. Ambassador to South Korea," and "I look forward to meeting all of you in person soon." (함께 올라온 동영상에 등장한 스틸 대사는 영어와 한국어를 번갈아 말하면서 “다음 주한 미국 대사로 부임하게 돼 매우 영광”이라며 “곧 여러분을 직접 만나 뵙기를 기대한다”고 했다.)

Ambassador Steel completed the confirmation process in the U.S. Senate on the 17th of last month and has also received the agrément (consent to the appointment) from the South Korean government, so she is expected to assume her post soon. (스틸 대사는 지난달 17일 미 상원의 인준 절차를 마쳤고 한국 정부의 아그레망(주재국 부임 동의)도 받아 조만간 부임할 것으로 예상된다.)

Ambassador Steel becomes the second Korean-American U.S. Ambassador to South Korea, following former Ambassador Sung Kim (served from 2011 to 2014) during the Obama administration. (스틸 대사는 오바마 행정부 시절 성 김 전 대사(2011∼2014년 재임) 이후 두 번째 한국계 주한 미국 대사가 된다.)

The position of U.S. Ambassador to South Korea had been vacant since former Ambassador Philip Goldberg, appointed under the Joe Biden administration, left his post in January of last year. The vacancy in the ambassadorship is resolved after about a year and six months. (주한 미국 대사직은 조 바이든 행정부에서 임명된 필립 골드버그 전 대사가 지난해 1월 이임한 후 비어 있었다. 대사직 공백은 약 1년 6개월 만에 해소된다.)

Born in Seoul in 1955, Steel comes from an immigrant family that moved to the U.S. in 1975. After serving as an elected member of the California State Board of Equalization and as an Orange County Supervisor (chief administrative officer), she served four years as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives starting in 2021. (1955년 서울에서 태어난 스틸 후보자는 1975년 미국으로 이주한 이민자 가족 출신이다. 캘리포니아주 조세형평국 선출 위원, 오렌지카운티 수퍼바이저(행정책임자) 등을 역임한 뒤 지난 2021년부터 4년간 공화당 소속 연방 하원 의원을 지냈다.)

item.title: Chung Jin-suk Meets Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho, Stating "Supplemental Investigation Authority Must Be Preserved" (정점식, 정성호 법무장관 만나 “보완수사권 존치해야”)
item.description:
Chung Jin-suk Meets Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho, Stating "Supplemental Investigation Authority Must Be Preserved" (정점식, 정성호 법무장관 만나 “보완수사권 존치해야”)

People Power Party Floor Leader Chung Jin-suk, during a meeting with Justice Minister Chung Sung-ho on the 8th, referenced the Jang Yoon-gi case, stating, "To wipe away the tears of the victims, the prosecution's supplemental investigation authority must be preserved." (국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 8일 정성호 법무부장관을 접견한 자리에서 장윤기 사건을 언급하며 “피해자의 눈물을 닦아주기 위해 검찰 보완수사권을 존치해야 한다”고 했다.)

Floor Leader Chung met Minister Chung at the PPP floor leader's office in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, saying, "Abolishing the prosecution's supplemental investigation authority would immediately lead to complete police control. It would mean a total monopoly of investigative power by the police." (정 원내대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국민의힘 원내대표실에서 정 장관을 만나 “검찰 보완수사권 폐지는 곧 경수완독. 경찰의 수사권 완전 독점”이라며 이같이 말했다.)

Referring to Jang Yoon-gi's rape and murder case of a high school girl in Gwangju, Floor Leader Chung said, "The problem is that without the prosecution's supplemental investigation, there was a high likelihood that the truth of this case would have been permanently concealed." Police, who initially investigated the murder of a Gwangju high school girl on May 5, applied a simple murder charge to Jang Yoon-gi and sent the case to the prosecution just nine days later. However, the prosecution, upon receiving the case, conducted a supplemental investigation, uncovering that Jang's father, who was a police officer, had destroyed some evidence, and indicted Jang on charges of murder including rape, rather than simple murder. (정 원내대표는 장윤기의 광주 여고생 강간 살인 사건을 언급하며 “문제는 검찰의 보완 수사가 없었다면 이번 사건의 진상이 영원히 은폐됐을 가능성이 컸다는 점”이라고 했다. 지난 5월 5일 발생한 전남 광주 여고생 피살 사건을 처음 수사한 경찰은 장윤기에게 단순 살인 혐의를 적용해 9일 만에 검찰에 송치했다. 하지만 사건을 넘겨받은 검찰이 보완수사를 통해 경찰인 장의 부친이 일부 증거를 폐기한 사실 등을 밝혀내며 검찰은 단순 살인이 아닌 강간 등 살인 혐의로 기소했다.)

Floor Leader Chung pointed out that the discussion on abolishing the supplemental investigation authority is being degenerated into a tool for the Democratic Party of Korea's party convention. He said, "This issue should be thoroughly handled from the perspective of victims and the public, but it is becoming a subject of internal political strife aimed at the Democratic Party's convention. I want to ask whether the tears and grievances of victims and their families are invisible to the Lee Jae-myung government. Are the venting and stress relief of the party's hardline supporters more important?" (정 원내대표는 보완수사권 폐지 논의가 더불어민주당의 전당대회용으로 변질되고 있다는 점을 지적했다. 그는 “이 문제는 철저히 피해자와 국민의 관점에서 다뤄야 할 사건인데 다분히 민주당 전당대회를 겨냥한 당내 정쟁의 소재가 되고 있다”며 “이재명 정부에 피해자와 그 가족들의 눈물, 억울함은 보이지 않는 것인지 묻고 싶다. 당 강성 지지자들의 분풀이, 스트레스 해소가 먼저냐”고 했다.)

He added, "Wasn't the justification for prosecutorial reform supposed to be checking the omnipotent power of the prosecution? Then, now, you must present an alternative on how to respond to the police's monopoly over investigative power." (그러면서 “무소불위의 검찰권을 견제한다는 것이 검찰 개혁의 명분 아니었나. 그럼 이제는 경찰 수사권 독점에 어떻게 대응할 건지 대안을 내놔야 한다”고 했다.)

In response, Minister Chung said, "The government's basic stance is to abolish the supplemental investigation authority, but since the final authority lies with the National Assembly, I ask for thorough discussions." Minister Chung, who has argued for the necessity of the supplemental investigation authority, recently told reporters, "Even if the government has a stance, don't the lawmakers there say that legislative power lies with the National Assembly? Won't the distinguished lawmakers discuss it well?" (이에 정 장관은 “정부 입장은 보완수사권 폐지를 기본적 입장으로 하고 있지만 국회에 최종 권한이 있는 만큼 충분한 논의를 해주길 부탁드린다”고 했다. 보완수사권 필요성을 주장해 온 정 장관은 최근 기자들과 만나 “정부의 입장이 있다고 하더라도 저기 계신 분(민주당 의원)이 입법권은 국회에 있다고 말하지 않는가”라며 “훌륭하신 의원들이 잘 논의하지 않겠나”라고 했었다.)

That day, he also said, "Floor Leader Chung is also an outstanding legal professional. I earnestly ask him to actively participate in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and convey various concerns." He added, "Regardless of the bill, the majority party might ultimately pass it through a vote as a last resort, but my personal belief is that before such a process, the ruling and opposition parties should meet and sufficiently consult and discuss. I ask the opposition party to actively participate in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee and vocally express public concerns and the alternatives proposed by the opposition party during such discussions." (그는 이날도 “(정) 원내대표도 훌륭한 법조인 출신인데 법사위에 꼭 참여해서 여러 우려 전달하길 간곡히 부탁드린다”고 했다. 그러면서 “어떤 법안이든 최후 수단으로 다수당이 표결로 의결할 수도 있겠지만 그런 과정이 있기까지는 여야가 만나서 충분히 협의하고 대화해야 한다는 게 개인적 소신”이라며 “야당에서 법사위에 적극 참여해서 그런 논의 과정에서 국민적 우려를, 야당이 제시한 대안들을 적극 말해주기를 부탁드린다”고 했다.)

After meeting with Floor Leader Chung for about ten minutes, Minister Chung met with reporters and said regarding the supplemental investigation authority, "I suggested that it would be good for the opposition party to actively voice their opinions and present alternatives during the legislative process in the National Assembly." (정 장관은 약 10여 분간 정 원내대표를 예방하고 난 뒤 기자들과 만나 보완수사권과 관련해 “국회 입법 과정에 야당도 적극적으로 목소리 내고 대안 제시하는 게 좋지 않겠냐는 말씀을 드렸다”고 했다.)

When asked if the government's stance had changed somewhat, he said, "Since the government concluded its stance on abolishing the supplemental investigation authority, the basic position is to adequately address any potential concerns and create a solid alternative. If there are expected issues from abolishing the supplemental investigation authority, we need to develop measures to address them, and it is important to establish institutional mechanisms to ensure that the demand for supplemental investigation is effective while preventing police from abusing their authority." (정부 입장이 다소 달라진 것 아니냐는 질문에는 “정부 입장이 보완수사권 폐지로 결론 났기 때문에, 나올 수 있는 우려 사항들을 충분히 보완해서 확실히 대안을 만들어줘야 한다는 게 기본 입장”이라며 “보완수사권 폐지했을 때 예상 가능한 문제점이 있다면 그런 점에 대한 보완책을 만들어줘야 하고, 보완 수사 요구가 실효성을 가질 수 있도록 또 경찰이 권한 남용하지 않도록 하는 제도적 장치를 만드는 게 중요하다”고 했다.)

item.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs Selects Three Outstanding Embassy Cases for 'K-Initiative'... Awards Performance Bonuses (외교부, ‘K-이니셔티브’ 우수 공관 사례 3건 선정…포상금 지급)
item.description:
Ministry of Foreign Affairs Selects Three Outstanding Embassy Cases for 'K-Initiative'... Awards Performance Bonuses (외교부, ‘K-이니셔티브’ 우수 공관 사례 3건 선정…포상금 지급)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 8th that it has selected three outstanding cases from overseas diplomatic missions that contributed to the spread of the 'K-Initiative' and paid a total of 9 million won in special performance bonuses. (외교부는 ‘K-이니셔티브’ 확산에 기여한 재외공관 우수 사례 3건을 선정해 특별성과 포상금 총 900만원을 지급했다고 8일 밝혔다.)

The K-Initiative is a key national strategy of the Lee Jae-myung administration, which involves proactively utilizing Korean culture to solve international issues and promote national interests. (K-이니셔티브란 대한민국의 문화를 활용해 주도적으로 국제 현안을 해결하고 국익을 증진한다는 내용으로, 이재명 정부의 핵심 국가 전략이다.)

The Ministry selected three outstanding cases from the Embassy in Egypt, the Consulate General in Qingdao, and the Embassy in Peru, awarding 3 million won each to three primary contributors. (외교부는 주이집트대사관, 주칭다오총영사관, 주페루대사관의 우수 사례 3건을 선정하고 주된 공적자 3명에게 포상금을 각각 300만원씩 지급했다.)

These outstanding cases involve projects where overseas diplomatic missions, through the K-Initiative consultative bodies they operate, established preliminary project plans and collaborated with public institutions, companies, and overseas Koreans to achieve concrete results such as export contracts or revenue generation. (우수사례들은 재외공관이 운영하는 K-이니셔티브 협의체를 통해 사전 사업 계획을 수립하고 공공기관과 기업, 동포 등이 협업해 수출 계약이나 매출 달성 등 구체적인 성과를 이뤄낸 사업들이다.)

The Embassy in Egypt held a 'Korean Culture Week' in May last year to introduce Korean culture to the local community, resulting in over 160 export consultations worth approximately $8.5 million (around 12.8 billion won). As a result, contracts worth over $600,000 (around 900 million won) were actually signed. A total of 15,000 people participated in the Korean Culture Week in Egypt. (주이집트대사관은 지난 5월 현지 사회에 한국 문화를 소개하는 ‘한국 문화 주간’을 개최한 결과 160여 건, 약 850만달러(약 128억원) 규모의 수출 상담이 이뤄졌다. 그 결과 총 60만달러(약 9억원) 이상의 계약이 실제 성사됐다. 이집트 한국 문화 주간엔 총 1만5000여 명이 참가했다.)

The Consulate General in Qingdao participated as a guest of honor at the 'Shandong Province Imported Goods Expo' in April, operated a Korea Pavilion, and promoted products from 586 Korean companies. This led to on-site sales of products worth $53,500 (around 80 million won), and tourism promotional post views exceeded 59,700. (주칭다오총영사관은 지난 4월 ‘산둥성 수입 상품 박람회’에 주빈국으로 참가해 한국관을 운영하고 586개 우리 기업 제품을 홍보했다. 이를 통해 5만3500달러(약 8000만원) 상당의 제품을 현장에서 판매했고, 관광 홍보 게시물 조회 수도 5만9700회를 넘겼다.)

The Embassy in Peru held a Korea Expo on the occasion of 'Korea-Peru Friendship Day' in March, operating booths to introduce corporate products and hosting K-pop and traditional cultural performances. This resulted in sales of over $100,000 (around 150 million won) worth of products from local overseas Korean-run businesses. (주페루대사관은 지난 3월 ‘한-페루 우정의 날’을 계기로 한국 박람회를 열고 기업 제품 소개 부스 운영, K-팝 및 전통문화 공연 등을 진행했다. 이를 통해 10만달러(약 1억5000만원) 이상의 현지 동포 업체 제품을 판매했다.)

The Ministry stated, "We will strengthen cooperation with our public institutions, business community, overseas Korean society, and local governments, centering on overseas diplomatic missions, which serve as local bridgeheads for the overseas expansion of our culture, businesses, and industries." It added, "We will continue to make efforts to accelerate the spread of the K-Initiative and produce tangible results that the public can feel." (외교부는 “우리 문화, 기업, 산업 등 해외 진출의 현지 교두보인 재외공관을 중심으로 우리 공공기관, 경제계, 동포 사회, 지자체 등과의 협력을 강화해 나가겠다”며 “K-이니셔티브 확산을 가속화하고 국민들이 체감할 수 있는 가시적 성과를 도출해 나가기 위한 노력을 계속 경주해 나갈 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

This marks the fourth time the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has paid special performance bonuses this year. Previously, in March, the Ministry paid a total of 6.05 million won to 12 employees who contributed to the President's visits to China and Japan; in April, a total of 100 million won to 23 employees of the Embassy in Iran related to the Middle East crisis; and in May, a total of 45.5 million won to 37 employees who contributed to responding to the Middle East War and supply chain crisis. (이번 외교부 특별 성과 포상금 지급은 올 들어 총 4번째다. 앞서 외교부는 지난 3월 대통령 방중·방일 유공 직원 12명에게 총 605만원, 4월 중동 위기 관련 주이란대사관 직원 23명에게 총 1억원, 5월 중동전쟁 및 공급망 위기 등 대응 유공 직원 37명에게 총 4550만원을 지급한 바 있다.)

item.title: Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Rep. Koh Min-jung Declares Candidacy for Party Leadership "Will Build a Young Democratic Party, Succeeding Moon Jae-in and Supporting Lee Jae-myung" (고민정 당대표 출마 선언 “젊은 민주당, 문재인 계승·이재명 뒷받침 민주당 만들겠다”)

Rep. Koh Min-jung of the Democratic Party of Korea officially declared her candidacy for the party leadership election at the August 17 National Convention on the 8th. (더불어민주당 고민정 의원이 8일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다.)

At a press conference held at the National Assembly Communication Hall that morning, Rep. Koh stated, "I will create a path for a young Democratic Party that listens to the voices of youth externally and nurtures youth internally." She added, "I will work to ensure the Democratic Party becomes a 'party for everyone' that represents the interests of the majority of the people and improves their lives one by one." She further noted, "I will take the lead in creating a Democratic Party that inherits the achievements of Moon Jae-in, which have been undermined by the Yoon Suk-yeol government, and supports the success of a Lee Jae-myung administration." (고 의원은 이날 오전 국회 소통관에서 출마 기자회견을 하고 “밖으로는 청년의 목소리를 듣고, 안으로는 청년을 키우는 젊은 민주당의 길을 만들어 내겠다”고 했다. “민주당이 국민 다수의 이해를 대변하고 국민의 삶을 하나씩 개선해 나가는 ‘모두의 민주당’이 될 수 있도록 하겠다”고도 했다. 그러면서 “윤석열 정부에서 훼손한 문재인의 성과를 계승하고, 이재명 정부의 성공을 뒷받침하는 민주당을 만드는 데 앞장서겠다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh emphasized, "The Democratic Party, as the ruling party responsible for the people's lives alongside a Lee Jae-myung administration, bears an endless responsibility for the daily lives of the people and the future of the Republic of Korea." (고 의원은 “민주당은 이재명 정부와 함께 국민의 삶을 책임져야 하는 집권 여당으로, 국민의 일상과 대한민국의 미래에 대한 무한 책임이 우리의 어깨 위에 있다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh remarked, "However, in the recent local elections, public sentiment dealt a harsh blow to the Democratic Party. In particular, the youth in their 20s and 30s completely turned their backs on us." She criticized, "To them, the Democratic Party was seen as 'a vested interest group that created and ignored disparities,' 'a hypocritical force that climbed the ladder of social mobility and then kicked it away,' and 'a faction that focused on issues far removed from people's lives, repeating internal conflicts while neglecting to care for the public.'" (고 의원은 “그런데 지난 지방선거에서 민심은 민주당에 회초리를 드셨다”며 “특히 2030 청년 세대는 민주당을 철저하게 외면했다”고 했다. 이어 “그들에게 민주당은 ‘격차를 만들고 방치한 기득권 세력’ ‘계층 이동 사다리를 오른 뒤 걷어차 버린 위선적 세력’ ‘국민의 생활과는 거리가 먼 이슈로 우리 안의 갈등을 반복하며 국민의 삶을 돌보는 데는 부족한 세력’이었다”고 비판했다.)

Rep. Koh stressed, "Our Democratic Party must start anew by acknowledging this. Faced with the warning of public sentiment, we must intensely reflect on what we lacked and seek alternatives." (고 의원은 “이것을 인정하는 것에서 우리 민주당이 다시 시작해야 한다”며 “민심의 경고 앞에 우리가 부족했던 것이 무엇인지 치열하게 성찰하고 대안을 모색하는 것이 지금 우리가 해야 할 일”이라고 강조했다.)

Regarding internal party strife, Rep. Koh said, "If we remain mired in power struggles and repeat worthless debates unrelated to people's lives, winning general elections or regaining power will become difficult. We must set aside branding and derogatory language, recognize one another, communicate, and find alternatives." (고 의원은 당 내분과 관련해 “우리가 권력 투쟁에 매몰돼 국민 삶과 아무 관련도 없는 무가치한 논쟁을 반복한다면 총선 승리도, 정권 재창출도 어려워질 것”이라며 “낙인 찍기와 멸칭의 언어를 거두고, 상대를 인정하고 소통하며 대안을 찾아 나가야 한다”고 했다.)

Rep. Koh pledged that if elected party leader, she would introduce a 'youth quota system' allocating a certain percentage of party positions in the central and regional chapters to young people, and a 'party member deliberation committee' for thorough discussion in major policy decisions. She also proposed establishing a 'Youth Future Committee' directly under the party leader, with its chairperson being the youth deputy leader of the central party, to create a process for direct communication and discussion with the party leader. (고 의원은 당대표가 되면 중앙당과 시·도당 당직 일정 비율을 청년에게 주는 ‘청년 당직 할당제’와 당의 주요 정책 결정 과정에서 숙의를 거치는 ‘당원공론화위원회’를 도입하겠다고 했다. 또 당대표 직속으로 ‘청년미래위원회’를 두고, 위원장은 중앙당 청년부대표로 해 당대표와 직접 소통하고 논의하는 절차를 만들겠다고 했다.)

With Rep. Koh's candidacy, the Democratic Party leadership election will become a four-way race, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, who previously declared his candidacy, former leader Song Young-gil, who announced his candidacy on the same day, and former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, who is expected to seek re-election. (고 의원의 출마로 민주당 당대표 선거는 앞서 출마를 선언한 김민석 전 국무총리와 이날 출마를 선언하는 송영길 전 대표, 연임 도전이 전망되는 정청래 전 대표까지 4파전으로 치러진다.)

Rep. Koh is the only female candidate in her 40s among the four contenders. She was previously elected as a Supreme Council member in the party convention held in August 2022. <<>> (고 의원은 후보 4인 가운데 유일한 40대 여성 주자다. 2022년 8월 전당대회에서 최고위원 선거에 출마해 당선된 바 있다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae on Preferential Voting Debate: "You Can't Do Anything While Violating Party Constitution and Rules" (정청래, 선호투표제 논란에 “당헌·당규 위반하면서 뭘 할 수는 없는 것”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae on Preferential Voting Debate: "You Can't Do Anything While Violating Party Constitution and Rules" (정청래, 선호투표제 논란에 “당헌·당규 위반하면서 뭘 할 수는 없는 것”)

Regarding the decision by the Democratic Party of Korea's National Convention Preparation Committee to adopt a preferential voting system for the August 17 party leadership election, former Representative Jung Cheong-rae stated on the 8th, "You can't do anything while violating the party constitution and rules." Although Jung had said the previous day, "I respect and accept the committee's decision," the pro-Jung faction released a statement that day opposing the preferential voting system, claiming it is invalid as a violation of the party constitution and rules. (더불어민주당 전당대회준비위원회가 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거를 선호투표제 방식으로 하기로 결정한 데 대해 정청래 전 대표는 8일 “당헌·당규를 위반하면서 무엇을 할 수는 없는 것”이라고 말했다. 정 전 대표는 전날 “전준위 결정을 존중하고 수용한다”고 했었으나, 친청계는 이날 선호투표제에 대해 당헌·당규 위반으로 무효라며 반대한다는 입장을 내놨다.)

After attending a policy forum on the success of the southwestern semiconductor cluster held at the National Assembly Members' Office Building that morning, Jung met with reporters and said, "Yesterday, I said I respect and accept the decision of the National Convention Preparation Committee, but since then, there has been controversy over violations of the party constitution and rules, so I reviewed them." (정 전 대표는 이날 오전 국회의원회관에서 열린 ‘서남권 반도체 클러스터 성공을 위한 정책 토론회’에 참석한 뒤 기자들과 만나 “어제 전준위(전당대회준비위원회) 결정을 존중하고 수용한다고 말했는데, 그 이후로 당헌·당규 위반이라는 논란이 있어 당헌·당규를 살펴봤다”고 했다.)

Jung then looked at notes he had saved on his phone and said, "According to Article 25, Paragraph 1, Clause 4 of the party constitution, it states, 'The party leader is elected by a majority of votes. Specific matters such as conducting a runoff election for this purpose are determined by party rules.' And Article 66 (Paragraph 1, Clause 1) of the party rules (Regulations on Election of Party Officers) states, 'In the party leadership election, the candidate receiving a majority of votes is elected. The specific method for conducting a runoff election for this purpose is set by the National Convention Preparation Committee but is finalized through resolutions by the Supreme Council and the Party Affairs Committee, and the specific voting method is determined by the Election Management Committee.'" (정 전 대표는 이어 휴대전화에 적어둔 메모를 보며 “당헌 25조 1항 4호를 보면, ‘당대표는 과반수의 득표로 선출한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시 등 구체적인 사항은 당규로 정한다’고 돼 있고, 당규(당직선출규정) 66조(1항 1호)에는 ‘당대표 선거는 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 한다. 이를 위한 결선투표 실시의 구체적인 방법은 전준위에서 정하되, 최고위원회와 당무위원회의 의결을 통해 확정하며, 구체적인 투표 방법은 선거관리위원회가 정한다’고 돼 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "When I heard this, I thought, 'What do we do?'" effectively lending weight to the claim that implementing preferential voting instead of a runoff election violates the party constitution and rules. Jung said, "Just as you can't do anything while violating the constitution and laws, isn't it also not permissible to conduct the party leadership election while violating the party constitution and rules? I was also quite taken aback." (그러면서 “저도 이 이야기를 듣고 ‘어떡하나’ 하는 생각이 들었다”며 결선투표가 아닌 선호투표를 하는 것이 당헌·당규 위반이라는 주장에 사실상 무게를 실었다. 정 전 대표는 “헌법·법률을 위반하면서 (무엇을) 할 수 없듯이, (당대표 선거를) 당헌·당규를 위반하면서 할 수 있는 것은 아니지 않으냐”며 “저도 좀 당혹스러웠다”고 했다.)

Jung stated, "I have no intention of quibbling over the primary election rules, but if there is a potential controversy over violating the party constitution and rules, it will cause significant confusion among party members, so I hope it gets sorted out well. I hope the National Convention Preparation Committee or the Supreme Council will make a wise decision." (정 전 대표는 “경선 룰을 갖고 시비를 할 생각이 없지만, 당헌·당규 위반 논란 소지가 있으면 당원들 사이에 큰 혼란이 있기 때문에, 어쨌든 잘 정리됐으면 좋겠다”며 “전준위나 최고위에서 현명하게 잘 결정하기를 바란다”고 했다.)

Former Representative Song Young-gil, who announced his candidacy that morning, said of the preferential voting system, "It eliminates the vote-splitting psychology," adding, "For me, it seems like it could be a winning card." Regarding this remark, Jung said, "If he said that, wouldn't it be a good thing if it benefits him?" He added, "I'm taking the position of accepting the committee's decision without considering advantages or disadvantages." (이날 오전 출마 선언을 한 송영길 전 대표는 선호투표제에 대해 “사표 심리가 없어지게 됐다”며 “저로서는 승리의 카드가 된 것 아닌가 싶다”고 했다. 이 발언에 대해 정 전 대표는 “그렇게 말씀하셨다면, 본인에게 유리하다면 좋은 것 아니겠느냐”고 했다. 그러면서 “저는 유불리를 생각하지 않고 전준위 결정을 수용한다는 입장”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil Announces Candidacy for Party Leader: “I Will Turn a Shaky Party into a True Ruling Party” (송영길 당대표 출마 선언 “흔들리는 당을 ‘진짜 여당’으로 만들겠다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil Announces Candidacy for Party Leader: “I Will Turn a Shaky Party into a True Ruling Party” (송영길 당대표 출마 선언 “흔들리는 당을 ‘진짜 여당’으로 만들겠다”)

Former Democratic Party of Korea leader Song Young-gil officially declared his candidacy for the party leadership in the August 17 national convention on the 8th, stating, “I will transform our shaky party into a true ruling party once again.” (더불어민주당 송영길 전 대표가 8일 “흔들리는 당을 다시 진짜 여당으로 탈바꿈시키겠다”며 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거 출마를 공식 선언했다.)

In a press conference held at the party headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, former leader Song asserted, “The success of the President Yoon administration is synonymous with the Democratic Party’s responsibility. The president should not have to walk through a thorny path alone; the Democratic Party must walk that path together.” <<> Referring to the June 1 local elections, Song said, “It was a defeat disguised as victory. The people have shown the Democratic Party a yellow card in this local election. If we take it lightly, the next general election will be a red card.” He added, “Losing the general election will mean no chance of regaining power, and without regaining power, we cannot guarantee the success of the Yoon administration.” <<> Song characterized this convention as “a choice not about who is more progressive, but about who can earn the people’s trust and lead the Democratic Party to victory—someone who will cooperate with the Yoon administration to create an irreplaceable Republic of Korea.” <<> “Whose face should we present for the general election?” Song questioned, claiming, “Song Young-gil is the winning card for the general election. I have experience in stabilizing a shaken party.” He argued, “After the crushing defeat in the April 7 by-elections in 2021, I became the party leader, restored the collapsed center of the party, and conducted the fierce primary for the presidential election more fairly than anyone else.” <<> If elected party leader again, Song pledged, “I will decisively tame the runaway housing market. By developing hundreds of thousands of pyeong of the returned U.S. military base site in Yongsan, Seoul, I will supply 50,000 apartments of 24 to 32 pyeong at reasonable prices to youth, newlyweds, and non-homeowners.” He also said, “Public rental housing on public land will allow renters to buy homes at the initial sales price anytime, and if housing prices rise, that increase will be shared with the renters.” <<> Song stated, “I will send 100,000 young people who are unable to find jobs abroad, supporting their airfare and stay expenses.” He also promised, “The university dormitory occupancy rate will be raised from the current 20% to 50%.” Additionally, he said, “I will remove the obstacles blocking the stock market’s upward trend. Once elected, I will pass the ‘Stock Price Suppression Prevention Act,’ promote separate taxation of dividend income, and create a ‘Super ISA (Individual Savings Account)’ for youth to build their seed money.” <<> Regarding party operations, Song proposed, “I will achieve party member sovereignty through AI (Artificial Intelligence),” and announced the creation of an ‘AI Party Members’ Square’ where members can express opinions. He also promised to build a ‘Digital Direct Democracy Policy Reflection System’ to convey members’ views to the presidential office and government for incorporation into state affairs. Noting that “without the support of the 2030 generation, there will be no election victory in 2030,” Song pledged to appoint two ex-officio supreme council members from the 20s and 30s age groups and establish a ‘2030 Special Committee’ to involve that generation in major party decisions. <<> After the press conference, in a meeting with reporters, Song commented on the previous day’s decision by the party convention preparation committee to hold the leadership election using a preferential voting system, saying, “Since anyone who votes for both first and second choices will have their votes combined, resulting in a majority winner, this creates an atmosphere where people can vote for Song Young-gil without burden. I think this has become a winning card for me.” <<> Attending the press conference were lawmakers Min Hong-chul (four-term), Kim Young-ho (three-term), Min Byeong-deok and Heo Jong-sik (two-term), Park Seon-won (first-term), and former lawmaker Kim Doo-gwan. Former presidential spokesman Kang Min-seok, who served under the Moon Jae-in administration, hosted the declaration event. <<> Former leader Song, a six-term lawmaker, was elected Democratic Party leader in May 2021 and oversaw the party’s primary for the presidential election, which unfolded between President Yoon and former Prime Minister Lee Nak-yon. He resigned as party leader in May 2022, taking responsibility for President Yoon’s defeat by a 0.73 percentage point margin to former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Subsequently, he ran as the Democratic Party candidate for Seoul mayor in the June 2022 local elections and lost. After the ‘money envelopes at the national convention’ scandal emerged, he left the party and was indicted in custody. He was acquitted in the second trial in February and reinstated in the party. (송 전 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 당사에서 출마 기자회견을 하고 “이재명 정부의 성공은 곧 민주당의 책임”이라며 “대통령 혼자 가시밭길을 걸어가게 해서는 안 된다. 민주당이 함께 그 길을 걸어야 한다”고 주장했다.)

item.title: Joint Rally of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academy Alumni Associations: "Reconsider Military Academy Integration from Square One" (육·해·공사 총동창회 궐기대회…“사관학교 통합, 원점 재검토하라”)
item.description:
Joint Rally of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academy Alumni Associations: "Reconsider Military Academy Integration from Square One" (육·해·공사 총동창회 궐기대회…“사관학교 통합, 원점 재검토하라”)

The alumni associations of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies held a general rally on the 8th, voicing unified opposition to the government's policy on integrating the military academies. (육군·해군·공군사관학교 총동창회가 8일 총궐기대회를 열고 정부의 사관학교 통합 정책에 일제히 반대 목소리를 냈다.)

On that morning, the joint alumni associations of the three academies, alongside People Power Party lawmakers Han Ki-ho and Lim Jong-deuk, held a rally on the steps of the main building of the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, under the banner "National General Rally Against the Merger of the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies and the Relocation of the Army Academy." They demanded the halt of the academy integration push and a "return to square one for reconsideration." (육·해·공사 총동창회는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회 본관 계단에서 국민의힘 한기호·임종득 의원 등과 함께 ‘육·해·공군사관학교 통폐합 및 육군사관학교 지방 이전 반대 국민 총궐기대회’를 개최하고 사관학교 통합 추진 중단과 ‘원점 재검토’를 요구했다.)

This marks the first time the joint alumni associations have taken collective action on the issue of the . The event involved 42 organizations, including former Army Academy superintendents, as well as retired generals. Some opposition party lawmakers also joined as speakers before the main event began. According to the organizers, approximately 2,000 people participated. (육·해·공사 총동창회가 문제와 관련해 집단행동에 나선 것은 처음이다. 역대 육사 교장단을 비롯한 42개 단체와 예비역 장성 등이 참여했고 일부 야당 의원도 본행사 시작 전 발언자로 합류했다. 주최 측 추산 약 2000명이 참가했다.)

In the resolution adopted that day, the joint alumni associations stated, "The merger of the military academies and the relocation of the Army Academy to a provincial area are significant national issues that could affect the history, traditions, identity, expertise, and overall national security of the armed forces." They criticized the government, saying, "Despite the need for objective verification, public consensus, and social agreement, the government is pushing ahead with this hastily, ignoring these requirements." (육·해·공사 총동창회는 이날 결의문에서 “사관학교 통폐합과 육사 지방 이전은 국군의 역사와 전통, 정체성과 전문성, 국가 안보 전반에 영향을 미칠 수 있는 중대한 국가적 현안”이라며 “객관적인 검증과 국민적 공감대, 사회적 합의를 바탕으로 추진돼야 함에도 정부가 이를 무시한 채 졸속으로 추진하고 있다”고 했다.)

They further urged that if reforms to the military academies are truly necessary, a consultative body should be formed, including military experts, senior military figures, educators, and parents of cadets, to design the policy openly and objectively. (그러면서 만약 사관학교 개혁이 꼭 필요하다면 군사 전문가와 군 원로, 교육계, 사관생도 학부모 등이 참여하는 협의 기구를 구성해 공개적이고 객관적으로 정책을 설계해야 한다고 촉구했다.)

They added, "Until our demands are met, we will continue to fight within the bounds of the law for national security, the future of the armed forces, and the safety and peaceful lives of the people." (이어 “요구가 관철될 때까지 국가 안보와 국군의 미래, 국민의 안전과 평화로운 삶을 위해 합법적인 범위 내에서 끝까지 투쟁하겠다”고 했다.)

Park Pan-jun, head of the Army Academy Alumni Association, pointed out, "The merger promoted by the government does not contribute to strengthening joint operations or recruiting outstanding cadets. National security should not be used as an experiment or, even worse, as a political sacrifice." (박판준 육사 총동창회장은 “정부가 추진하는 통폐합은 합동성 강화나 우수 생도 모집에 도움이 되지 않는다”며 “안보는 실험 대상이 돼선 안 되고 정치적 제물이 되어선 더더욱 안 된다”고 지적했다.)

The alumni associations of the Naval Academy and Air Force Academy were represented by their respective secretaries-general, who each stated their positions. (해사, 공사 총동창회는 사무총장들이 참가해 각자 입장을 밝혔다.)

Jung Seok-kyun, Secretary-General of the Naval Academy Alumni Association, said, "Naval cadets must grow into naval officers while seeing and smelling the sea," warning that integration could undermine the expertise and identity of naval officers. Wi Kang-bok, Secretary-General of the Air Force Academy Alumni Association, also noted that under the integration plans under discussion, "It would be very difficult to timely cultivate elite officers specialized in air and space environments." (정석균 해사 총동창회 사무총장은 “해군사관생도는 바다를 보고 바다의 냄새를 맡으며 해군 장교로 성장해야 한다”며 통합이 해군 장교의 전문성과 정체성을 훼손할 수 있다고 했다. 위강복 공사 총동창회 사무총장도 논의 중인 통합 방안으로는 “공중, 우주 환경에 특화된 정예 장교를 적기에 양성하기가 매우 어렵다”고 했다.)

The Ministry of National Defense is pursuing a reform plan that would establish a "National Defense Academy" to integrate the selection of cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies, aiming to strengthen joint military capabilities. (국방부는 군의 합동성 강화 등을 위해 ‘국군사관학교’를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하는 개혁 방안을 추진 중이다.)

The plan envisions that first- and second-year students at the National Defense Academy would receive common education together for all three branches, while third- and fourth-year students would undergo specialized education for their respective services. The Jaundae area in Daejeon is being discussed within and outside the military as a potential site for the common education, but the Ministry of National Defense maintains that "specific plans have not been finalized." (국군사관학교 1·2학년엔 육·해·공군 생도가 함께 공통 교육을 받고, 3·4학년엔 각 군별 특화 전공 교육을 받도록 한다는 구상이다. 공통 교육 장소로는 대전 자운대가 군 안팎에서 거론되고 있지만, 국방부는 “구체적 방안은 확정되지 않았다”는 입장이다.)

item.title: President Lee Meets with Norwegian Prime Minister: "Congratulations on Reaching the World Cup Quarterfinals... I Watched the Video, You Played Well" (李대통령, 노르웨이 총리 회담 “월드컵8강 축하... 영상보니 잘 하더라“)
item.description:
President Lee Meets with Norwegian Prime Minister: "Congratulations on Reaching the World Cup Quarterfinals... I Watched the Video, You Played Well" (李대통령, 노르웨이 총리 회담 “월드컵8강 축하... 영상보니 잘 하더라“)

President Lee Jae-myung, who is visiting Türkiye for the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) Summit, held a summit meeting with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre on the 8th (local time) to discuss bilateral cooperation plans. (나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의 참석을 계기로 튀르키예를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 8일(현지 시각) 요나스 가르 스퇴르 노르웨이 총리와 정상회담을 하고 양국 협력 방안을 논의했다.)

During the 36-minute meeting with Prime Minister Støre, President Lee stated, "The current international situation is highly unstable," and emphasized that "at times like this, when it is limited for individual nations to overcome the crisis, international cooperation and exchange become even more important." He added, "South Korea and Norway are developing into a deep relationship where we greatly benefit each other in the fields of economy, industry, culture, and defense," and proposed, "Let's have an in-depth discussion on which areas we should further deepen our ties in the future." (이 대통령은 이날 스퇴르 총리와 36분간 가진 회담에서 “현재 국제 정세가 매우 불안정한 상태”라며 “국가 단위에서 이 위기를 극복하기에 제한적인 이런 때일수록 국가 간 협력과 교류가 중요하다”고 했다. 그러면서 “대한민국과 노르웨이는 경제, 산업, 문화, 국방 영역에서 큰 도움을 받는 깊은 관계로 발전하고 있다”며 “앞으로 어떤 분야에서 관계를 깊게 만들어갈지 깊이 있게 논의하자”고 했다.)

President Lee expressed familiarity by telling Prime Minister Støre, "This is the second time we meet," and then conveyed his gratitude, saying, "South Korea has not forgotten and remembers with appreciation that Norway provided medical support during the Korean War (1950-1953) even before establishing diplomatic relations with South Korea." (이 대통령은 스퇴르 총리에게 “두 번째 뵙는다”며 친근감을 표시한 뒤 “대한민국은 노르웨이가 대한민국과 외교 관계를 맺기도 전인 6·25(전쟁) 당시 의료 지원을 해준 점을 잊지 않고 기억하며 감사하게 생각한다”고 사의를 표했다.)

Prime Minister Støre responded to President Lee, saying, "I met you last year at the G20 Summit, and now we meet again," recalling, "I have fond memories of the extensive discussions we had about bilateral relations during the dinner last year, and since then, there has been significant development in the potential between Norway and South Korea." He continued, "There was an important decision in the defense sector between our two countries, and it was a good decision for advancing the strategic partnership," adding, "We continue to make progress in security, trade, and technology." This appears to refer to Hanwha Aerospace's contract signed earlier this year to supply a full package worth a total of $922 million (approximately 1.3 trillion won), including the Chunmoo rocket launcher and guided missiles, to Norway. (스퇴르 총리는 이 대통령에게 “작년 G20 정상회의를 계기로 뵙고 다시 만나게 됐다”며 “작년 만찬 때 대통령님과 양국 관계에 대해 많은 대화를 나눴던 좋은 기억이 나는데, 그 이후 노르웨이와 한국 간 잠재성에서 많은 발전이 있었다”고 했다. 이어 “양국 국방 분야에서 중요한 결정이 있었는데 전략 파트너십 발전을 위해 좋은 결정이었다”며 “안보·교역·기술 분야에서 (양국이 앞으로) 계속 나아가고 있다”고 했다. 이는 한화에어로스페이스가 올 초 노르웨이에 천무와 유도 미사일 등 총 9억2200만달러(약 1조3000억원) 규모의 풀패키지 공급 계약을 체결한 것 등을 거론한 것으로 보인다.)

During the meeting, President Lee also brought up Norway's advancement to the World Cup quarterfinals and the selection of a submarine jointly designed with Germany as the preferred bidder for Canada's submarine project. At the start of the meeting, President Lee mentioned to Prime Minister Støre, "I think I should first offer my congratulations. You made it to the World Cup quarterfinals and were also selected for the (Canadian) submarine project." (이 대통령은 회담에서 노르웨이가 월드컵 8강에 진출한 것과 함께 독일과 공동 설계한 잠수함이 캐나다 잠수함 사업 우선협상 대상자로 선정된 것을 화제로 올렸다. 이 대통령은 회담을 시작하며 스퇴르 총리에게 “먼저 축하 말씀을 드려야 할 것 같다. 월드컵 8강에도 가고 (캐나다) 잠수함 (사업) 선정도 됐다”고 언급한 것이다.)

Prime Minister Støre replied, "I am pleased with these achievements at the national level," adding, "This is the first time since 1998 that Norway has achieved such a high result in the World Cup, and defeating Brazil in the Round of 16 is also very gratifying." He continued, "We'll have to see how the match against England in the quarterfinals goes, but I think it will go well. We have many good players, and they are performing well as a team." In response, President Lee remarked, "I watched the video of the Norwegian team after the Round of 16, and they were very impressive," and then made the so-called Norwegian 'Viking clap' gesture by clenching his fists and mimicking a rowing motion, adding, "I hope I get to see you row one more time," conveying his support. (스퇴르 총리는 “국가 차원에서 성과를 내 기쁘다”며 “1998년 이후에 높은 월드컵 성적을 낸 것은 처음인데 (16강전에서) 브라질에 승리한 것 또한 매우 기쁘다”고 화답했다. 이어 “영국과 (월드컵 8강전) 경기가 어떻게 될지 지켜봐야겠지만, 잘될 것”이라며 “좋은 선수가 많지만, 팀으로 잘 선전하고 있다”고 했다. 이에 이 대통령은 “16강전 후 노르웨이팀 영상을 봤는데 아주 좋았다”며 주먹을 쥐고 노를 젓는 동작을 취하는 이른바 노르웨이의 ‘바이킹 노 젓기’ 응원 제스처를 해 보이고는 “한 번 더 젓길 기대한다”고 응원의 뜻을 전했다.)

item.title: Legislation Committee Unilaterally Pushes Forward... ‘Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights’ on Agenda (與 법사위 단독 강행... ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 상정)
item.description:
Legislation Committee Unilaterally Pushes Forward... ‘Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Rights’ on Agenda (與 법사위 단독 강행... ‘보완수사권 폐지’ 상정)

On the 8th, the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee held a plenary session led by the Democratic Party of Korea, following the walkout of the People Power Party in protest over committee formation negotiations and discussions on revising the Criminal Procedure Act. The Committee placed a bill to revise the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights, on the agenda of the plenary session, and it is expected to be reviewed by the First Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 10th. <<> People Power Party lawmakers protested inside the meeting room for about five minutes immediately after the session began. They held placards reading phrases like ‘Intimidation and disregard for the people in committee formation’ and ‘Building up to nullify trials through obsession with the Legislation Committee,’ then left the room. <<> Kim Seung-soo, the People Power Party’s Deputy Chief Whip for Operations, later told reporters, “The Legislation Committee must be normalized” and urged, “Acknowledge the opposition’s checks and balances, and have the Democratic Party immediately enter into good-faith negotiations on forming the committee.” <<> After the People Power Party lawmakers exited, Seo Young-kyo, the Democratic Party chair of the Legislation Committee, resumed the session. The Committee formed the First Subcommittee on Bill Review that day and placed the Criminal Procedure Act amendment on the agenda. Kim Yong-min, a Democratic Party member of the Committee, stated, “Only 86 days remain until the abolition of the prosecution service,” adding, “We must completely abolish prosecutors’ direct investigation and supplementary investigation rights and unify the investigative authority under judicial police officers.” He continued, “The separation of investigation and prosecution is a fundamental principle that must be upheld and can never be compromised.” <<> However, regarding the ‘Jang Yun-gi case,’ where suspicions of an organized cover-up by the police have emerged, opinions within the Democratic Party have surfaced about the need for supplementary mechanisms for police investigations. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Nam-hee said, “In cases like this, where police collude with suspects or destroy evidence, we need a system to prevent such occurrences or detect problems.” <<> In response, Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho stated, “Since the police have said they will conduct strict internal audits and prepare related measures, we will wait and see.” <<> Regarding suspicions of evidence tampering, Minister Chung explained, “There were 11 matters that were not properly handled at the police level and had to be supplemented by the prosecution. In that process, suspicions (related to evidence destruction) arose, leading to a thorough review.” <<> When asked if the prosecution was using this suspicion as ‘media play’ to argue for the necessity of supplementary investigation rights, Minister Chung rebutted, saying, “Necessary measures are being taken in Gwangju, and the media is intensively covering it, leading to articles. Suggesting that this is media play with ulterior motives is an excessive misunderstanding.” <<> Earlier that day, the People Power Party, through a commentary by Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon, criticized, “In a situation where suspicions of an organized police cover-up are pouring in, trying to eliminate checks and balances is not reform but an idea to turn power agencies into absolute power with no oversight.” <<> The Legislation Committee had planned to process 44 bills transferred from other standing committees that day, in addition to the Criminal Procedure Act amendment. However, Chair Seo stated, “The Democratic Party’s leadership requested that we defer the passage of bills from other standing committees to allow the People Power Party to attend the standing committees,” and announced that the processing of related agenda items would be postponed. <<> Meanwhile, lawmakers from the Democratic Party and the Fatherland Innovation Party on the Legislation Committee held a press conference that day and stated, “Reform of the criminal justice system is a task that can no longer be delayed,” adding, “We must open the First Subcommittee on Bill Review on the 10th and begin reviewing key bills, including the Criminal Procedure Act amendment to abolish prosecutors’ supplementary investigation rights.” (국회 법제사법위원회는 8일 국민의힘이 원 구성 협상과 형사소송법 개정 논의에 항의하며 퇴장한 가운데 더불어민주당 주도로 전체회의를 열었다. 법사위는 검사의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 전체회의에 상정하고, 오는 10일 법안심사1소위원회에서 심사할 전망이다.)

item.title: Opposition party’s decision on ‘preference voting’ for party leader... Pro-Chung faction protests, “Must withdraw immediately” (與 당대표 ‘선호 투표’ 결정에...친청계 반발 “당장 철회해야”)
item.description:
Opposition party’s decision on ‘preference voting’ for party leader... Pro-Chung faction protests, “Must withdraw immediately” (與 당대표 ‘선호 투표’ 결정에...친청계 반발 “당장 철회해야” )

In relation to the Democratic Party of Korea’s decision to adopt preference voting for the party leader election at the August 17 national convention, dissenting voices have emerged within the party. (더불어민주당이 8·17 전당대회에서 선출하는 당 대표 투표 방식을 선호도 투표로 하기로 결정한 것과 관련, 당 내부에서 반대 목소리가 나왔다.)

At the Supreme Council meeting on the 8th, Supreme Council member Lee Seong-yoon stated, “This is a clear violation of the party constitution and regulations, making it invalid,” adding, “While preference voting may be feasible for elections like floor leader or speaker elections, it is an unsuitable method for the party leader election, which involves a tour-based voting system.” (8일 최고위원회의에서 이성윤 최고위원은 “명백한 당헌·당규 위반으로 무효”라며 “실무적으로 선호투표 방법은 원내대표나 의장 선거 같은 선거에는 가능할 수 있지만 순회투표를 하는 당대표 선거에는 맞지 않는 방식”이라고 했다.)

Supreme Council member Moon Jeong-bok also said, “Introducing preference voting for the party leader election was supposed to be discussed again after the open Supreme Council meeting ends,” and added, “Changing the rules by amending the party constitution and regulations does not seem right.” (문정복 최고위원도 “당대표 선출에 선호투표를 도입하는 것은 공개 최고위가 끝나고 다시 논의하기로 했다”며 “당헌·당규를 개정하면서까지 룰을 바꾸는 것은 옳지 않은 것 같다”고 했다.)

The previous day, the party’s election preparatory committee announced that after discussing two methods, preference voting and runoff voting, they decided on preference voting. In this system, voters mark their first, second, and third preferred candidates on a single ballot. In the first tally, if a candidate secures a majority with first-preference votes alone, the winner is confirmed. If no candidate achieves a majority, a second tally includes second-preference votes, and if still no majority, a third tally includes third-preference votes. (전날 당 전당준비대회위원회는 선호투표와 결선투표 등 두 가지 방식을 논의한 결과 선호투표제로 결정했다고 밝혔다. 투표자가 1·2·3순위의 선호 후보를 한꺼번에 투표용지에 기입하고, 1차 집계에서 1순위 득표로만 과반을 얻은 후보가 나오면 당선자를 확정한다. 만약 과반 후보가 나오지 않을 경우 2차로 2순위까지 집계, 그래도 나오지 않으면 3차로 3순위까지 포함해 집계하는 방식이다.)

Some argue that this method favors pro-Lee Jae-myung candidates. This is because two out of the three early contenders for party leadership—former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae, former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and lawmaker Song Young-gil (Kim and Song)—are pro-Lee. Regardless of whether the first preference is for a pro-Lee candidate or Jeong, the second preference is likely to go to the remaining pro-Lee candidate. (일각에서는 친명(친이재명) 후보에게 유리한 방식이라는 주장도 나온다. 일찍이 당권 주자로 거론된 정청래 전 대표, 김민석 전 총리, 송영길 의원 3명 중 2명(김·송)이 친명이기 때문이다. 1순위가 친명이든 정 전 대표이든, 2순위에는 남은 친명 후보를 쓸 가능성이 높기 때문이다.)

The previous day, former Representative Jeong Cheong-rae said, “I respect and accept the election committee’s decision.” (전날 정청래 전 대표는 “전준위 결정을 존중하고 수용한다”고 했다.)

On the same day, lawmaker Cho Seung-rae, who previously served as the party’s secretary-general, wrote on Facebook, “Introducing preference voting for the party leader election violates the party constitution and regulations,” and urged, “Either withdraw it, or if you intend to implement it, amend the party constitution and regulations.” (같은 날 당 사무총장을 맡았던 조승래 의원도 페이스북에 “당대표 선출에 선호 투표를 도입하는 것은 당헌·당규 위반”이라며 “철회하든지, 시행하려면 당헌·당규 개정을 해야 한다”고 밝혔다.)

Cho added, “Article 25, Clause 4 of the party constitution explicitly mandates the implementation of runoff voting. The party regulations, Rule No. 4 on Election of Party Officers, also stipulate that a candidate with a majority of votes shall be elected, and runoff voting shall be conducted for this purpose.” (조 의원은 “당헌 제25조 4호에는 결선투표 실시를 명기하고 있다. 당규 제4호 당직선출규정에도 과반수 득표자를 당선인으로 하고 이를 위한 결선투표 실시를 규정하고 있다”고 했다.)

He further stated, “To implement preference voting, the clause on runoff voting for electing the party leader in the party constitution must be removed, or the party regulations must clearly define preference voting as a form of runoff voting.” <<>> (그러면서 “선호투표를 실시하려면 당헌상 대표선출 결선투표 조항을 들어내거나, 당규상 선호투표를 결선투표의 한 방법이라고 분명하게 정리하든지 해야한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Democrats also cautious about supplementary investigation power… Hong Ki-won of ruling party says "Concerns for harm to the weak, need deliberation" (민주당서도 보완수사권 신중론…與 홍기원 “약자 피해 우려, 숙의해야”)
item.description:
Democrats also cautious about supplementary investigation power… Hong Ki-won of ruling party says "Concerns for harm to the weak, need deliberation" (민주당서도 보완수사권 신중론…與 홍기원 “약자 피해 우려, 숙의해야”)

<<>> Voices of concern have emerged from within the Democratic Party of Korea, which has adopted as party policy the complete abolition of the prosecutor's supplementary investigation power without exception. Democratic Party lawmaker Hong Ki-won pointed out on the 8th that deliberation is necessary regarding the abolition of supplementary investigation power, citing the potential harm to socially vulnerable groups such as citizens and victims of sexual crimes. ()

On his Facebook page that day, Rep. Hong stated, "While eliminating the possibility of prosecutors' abuse of power and ensuring that political prosecutors never emerge again, we must undergo an in-depth deliberation process to consider whether there is room to retain a level of supplementary investigation power that minimizes harm to powerless and unjustly suffering victims." (예외 없는 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 당론으로 하는 더불어민주당 내부에서도 우려의 목소리가 나왔다. 홍기원 더불어민주당 의원이 8일 보완수사권 폐지와 관련, 숙의가 필요하다고 지적했다. 시민, 성범죄 피해자 등 사회적 약자들이 피해를 볼 수 있다는 이유에서다.)

Rep. Hong added, "Yesterday (the 7th), Acting Party Leader and Floor Leader Han Byung-do stated that 'the complete abolition of supplementary investigation power is unequivocal.' I recall that during the party caucus last March when discussing the laws on the Corruption Investigation Office and the Public Prosecution Service, several lawmakers raised the need for an exceptional retention of supplementary investigation power to protect powerless victims and to counterbalance the judicial police, who would monopolize investigative authority, and it was concluded that this would be discussed in earnest during future revisions of the Criminal Procedure Act." (홍 의원은 이날 자신의 페이스북에 “검사의 권한 남용 가능성을 없애고 정치검사가 다시는 나올 수 없도록 하면서도 힘없는 억울한 피해자를 최소화하는 수준의 보완수사권을 남겨둘 여지는 없는지, 심도 있는 숙의 절차를 거쳐야 한다”고 했다.)

He further said, "While opposing the retention of investigative power with potential for abuse by prosecutors, 'abolishing the investigative power of prosecutors' is not an end in itself but a reform to protect powerless victims and eradicate political prosecutors through this measure." (홍 의원은 “어제(7일) 한병도 당대표 직무대행 겸 원내대표께서 ‘보완수사권 완전 폐지는 확고부동’하다고 말씀하셨다”면서 “지난 3월 의총에서 공소청·중수청 법을 논의할 때 힘없는 피해자 보호 및 수사권을 독점하게 될 사법경찰관 견제를 위해 보완수사권의 예외적 존치 필요성을 제기한 의원들이 여럿 있었고 향후 형사소송법 개정 때 본격 논의키로 결론 낸 것으로 기억하고 있다”고 했다.)

He added, "With the establishment of the Public Prosecution Service and the Corruption Investigation Office, over 90% of prosecutors' investigative authority will be eliminated. In particular, arbitrary initiation of investigations and investigations into unrelated cases—which were typical abuses of prosecutorial power—have become impossible." He also emphasized, "The deliberation should not be one that presupposes a conclusion but rather one aimed at finding the optimal solution." (또 “검사에게 ‘남용 가능성이 있는 수사권 존치에 반대한다”면서도 “검수완박은 그 자체가 목적이 아니라 이를 통해 힘없는 피해자를 보호하고, 정치검사를 척결하기 위한 개혁”이라고 했다.)

On this day, the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee is set to deliberate the Criminal Procedure Act, which includes the complete abolition of supplementary investigation power. The People Power Party is likely to boycott the meeting in protest of the unilateral election of the committee chair. (그러면서 “중수청·공소청 설치로 검사의 수사권은 90% 이상 없어진다. 특히 검찰권 남용의 대표적 폐해였던 임의적 수사 개시, 별건 수사는 불가능하게 됐다”고 했다. 또 “결론을 정해놓고 하는 숙의가 아닌 최적의 해법을 찾아가기 위한 숙의가 되어야 할 것”이라고 강조했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk, visiting Incheon, launches fierce attack on "violation of suffrage rights" – "Re-run election is a matter of principle for restoring democracy" (인천 찾은 장동혁 ‘참정권 침해’ 맹공 “재선거, 민주주의 회복이라는 원칙의 문제”)
item.description:
People Power Party (PPP) leader Jang Dong-hyuk met with young party members in Incheon on the 8th and stated, “If the reality of the deprivation of suffrage rights is revealed through a special counsel (investigation into the National Election Commission), a re-run election must naturally follow,” adding, “This is not a matter of weighing advantages or disadvantages for any political party, but a matter of principle for restoring democracy.” (국민의힘 장동혁 대표는 8일 인천에서 청년 당원들을 만나 “(선관위) 특검을 통해 참정권 박탈 사태의 실체가 밝혀지면 당연히 재선거도 뒤따라야 한다”며 “어느 정당의 유불리를 따질 문제가 아니라, 민주주의 회복이라는 원칙의 문제”라고 했다.)

Jang made this remark at the ‘June 3rd Suffrage Deprivation Incident Incheon and Capital Region Youth Group Meeting’ held at the Incheon Metropolitan City Party office that afternoon, saying, “The voting for the local elections is over, but the local elections are not yet finished.” (장 대표는 이날 오후 인천광역시당에서 열린 ‘6·3 참정권 박탈 사태 인천·수도권 청년 단체 간담회’에 참석해 “지방선거 투표는 끝났지만, 지방선거는 아직 끝나지 않았다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Regarding the special counsel to investigate the shortage of ballot papers, Jang said, “The Democratic Party of Korea is proposing a special counsel recommended by a third party,” and criticized, “The main culprits who created the irresponsible, incompetent, and arrogant National Election Commission are President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party. Who can trust a special counsel led by them?” He added, “If all the truth is revealed through the special counsel, it will be shown that the mastermind of this incident is President Lee at the very top, and the accomplice is the Democratic Party. Therefore, the People Power Party must undoubtedly push for the special counsel.” (장 대표는 투표용지 부족 사태를 수사하기 위한 선관위 특검과 관련해 “더불어민주당이 제3자 추천 특검을 하자고 한다”며 “무책임하고 무능하고 오만한 선관위를 만든 주범이 바로 이재명 대통령과 민주당인데 그들이 주도하는 특검을 누가 믿을 수 있겠느냐”고 했다. 이어 “특검을 통해 모든 진실이 밝혀지면 이번 사태의 몸통은 맨 정점에 있는 이 대통령이고 공범은 민주당이라는 것이 밝혀질 것”이라며 “그렇기 때문에 반드시 국민의힘이 특검을 추진해야만 한다”고 했다.)

Jang also argued, “Early voting, which the people do not trust, should also be abolished,” and insisted, “We must switch to a French-style same-day voting and manual counting system.” He continued, “There is currently discussion within the parliamentary inspection committee about a recount and manual inspection,” and stressed, “It must be confirmed that the ballots have not been contaminated or damaged, and a recount and manual inspection should be conducted.” (장 대표는 “국민들이 믿지 못하는 사전투표도 이제 없애야 한다”며 “프랑스식 당일투표 수개표 제도로 바꿔야 한다”고 했다. 또 “지금 국정조사 특위에서 재검표 수개표에 대한 논의가 있다”며 “투표용지가 오염되거나 훼손되지 않았다는 걸 확인시키고 재검표 수개표가 이뤄져야 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3rd local elections, Jang plans to visit major cities nationwide, starting with Incheon, to attend rallies to protect suffrage rights. Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon of the PPP met with reporters at the National Assembly that afternoon and said, “In cities like Daegu, Busan, and Gwangju, spontaneous rallies led by young people are taking place,” adding, “We plan to visit these events to listen more concretely and vividly to the voices of those in their 20s and 30s.” He further stated, “The leader will attend the youth rallies after the official party-hosted events are over. Even just attending a spontaneously organized rally is meaningful.” (장 대표는 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 문제와 관련, 인천을 시작으로 전국 주요 도시를 돌며 참정권 수호 집회에 참석할 방침이다. 박성훈 국민의힘 수석대변인은 이날 오후 국회에서 기자들과 만나 “대구, 부산, 광주 등 여러 도시에서 청년들이 중심이 된 자발적인 집회가 진행 중”이라며 “그런 행사들을 찾아가 현장의 2030 목소리를 조금 더 구체적이고 생생하게 귀담아들을 예정”이라고 했다. 이어 “대표가 당 주관 공식 행사가 끝나고 청년들의 집회에 참석한다. 자발적으로 진행하는 집회에 참석하는 자체만으로도 의미가 있다”고 했다.)

Lawmaker Park Dae-chul, who attended the meeting, said, “Yesterday, the ‘gag law’ (revised Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection) came into effect, and on June 3rd, the absurd situation occurred where the right to vote was blocked,” and vowed, “I will devote all my efforts to building an election system that the youth and the people can agree with.” Supreme Council member Kim Min-soo also stated, “I believe that if the youth of South Korea, those in their 20s and 30s, had not risen up, the rule of law, freedom, democracy, and the electoral system would all have completely collapsed.” (간담회에 참석한 박대출 의원은 “어제는 입틀막법(개정 정보통신망법)이 시행되더니 6월 3일에는 투표할 권리가 틀어막히는 황당한 사태가 벌어졌다”면서 “청년 여러분과 국민이 동의하는 선거 시스템을 구축하는 데 전력을 기울이겠다”고 했다. 김민수 최고위원도 “대한민국 2030이 일어서지 않았다면 법치도, 자유도, 민주주의도, 선거제도도 모든 것이 완벽히 무너졌을 것이라고 생각한다”고 했다.)

Young party members also attended the meeting. Office worker Kang Hyung-kyu said, “I want to ask all those who criticize Leader Jang. Are you more afraid of a drop in the party’s approval rating than the reality of a precious vote being thrown away on the street?” Another young party member, Moon Geum-mi, said, “The only way to correct an election tainted by shortcomings and suspicions is through a re-run election.” (간담회에느 청년 당원들도 참석했다. 직장인 강형규 씨는 “장 대표님을 비판하는 모든 분께 묻고 싶다. 국민의 소중한 한 표가 길바닥에 버려진 현실보다 당 지지율이 떨어지는 게 더 두려우냐”고 했다. 청년 당원 문금미 씨는 “부실과 의혹으로 얼룩진 선거를 바로 잡는 유일한 방법은 재선거”라고 했다.)

Attending the meeting were key party officials including Secretary-General Jung Hee-yong, Organizational Deputy Secretary-General Kang Myung-goo, Senior Spokesperson Park Sung-hoon, Chief of the Floor Staff Kim Tae-gyu, Supreme Council members Shin Dong-wook, Jo Kwang-han, and Kim Min-soo, as well as lawmakers Seo Ji-young, Lee Dal-hee, and Kim Min-jeon. (이날 간담회엔 정희용 사무총장, 강명구 조직부총장, 박성훈 수석대변인, 김태규 원내수석대변인, 신동욱·조광한·김민수 최고위원 등 주요 당직자와 서지영·이달희·김민전 의원 등이 참석했다.)

item.title: Lee and Trump Reunite After Three Weeks… Agree on Follow-Up Talks for ‘Military Shipbuilding’ and Commit to Golf Meeting (李·트럼프, 3주만에 재회… ‘군용선박 건조’ 후속 협의, 골프 회동 확약)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung, currently visiting Ankara, Turkey, to attend the NATO summit, met with U.S. President Donald Trump again after three weeks, agreeing to launch working-level consultations for the construction of U.S. military vessels. Additionally, they formally confirmed the ‘golf meeting’ promised last month and decided to coordinate President Lee’s schedule for a visit to the United States. (나토(NATO) 정상회의 참석차 튀르키예 앙카라를 방문 중인 이재명 대통령이 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 3주 만에 다시 만나 미국 군용 선박 건조를 위한 실무 협의에 착수하기로 합의했다. 아울러 지난달 약속했던 ‘골프 회동’을 공식 확약하며 이 대통령의 방미 일정을 조율하기로 했다.)

Kang Yoo-jung, Senior Press Secretary at the Presidential Office, stated in a written briefing on the 8th (local time) that “President Lee attended a welcome dinner hosted by Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and his spouse on the evening of the 7th, engaging in extensive talks with NATO ally leaders, including U.S. President Donald Trump.” (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 8일(현지 시각) 서면 브리핑을 통해 “이 대통령이 7일 저녁 레제프 타이이프 에르도안 튀르키예 대통령 내외가 주최한 환영 만찬에 참석해 도널드 트럼프 미 대통령을 비롯한 나토 동맹국 정상들과 다각도로 환담했다”고 밝혔다.)

During the discussions that evening, President Lee spoke with U.S. President Trump, whom he met again three weeks after the G7 summit in Evian, France last month. After exchanging greetings at the dinner, the two leaders focused on follow-up measures for the ‘U.S. military shipbuilding project,’ which President Trump had personally requested from South Korea during the G7 meeting. (이날 환담에서 이 대통령은 지난달 프랑스 에비앙 G7 정상회의 이후 3주 만에 재회한 트럼프 미국 대통령과 대화를 나눴다. 두 정상은 만찬장에서 인사를 나눈 뒤, G7 회의 당시 트럼프 대통령이 한국 측에 직접 요청했던 ‘미국 군용 선박 건조 프로젝트’의 후속 조치를 집중적으로 논의했다.)

In response to President Trump’s request for cooperation on military shipbuilding, President Lee firmly expressed his determination to “cooperate as actively as possible.” He then introduced President Trump to the technical capabilities of leading domestic shipbuilding companies, which possess world-class expertise in constructing warships and vessels. (이 대통령은 이 자리에서 트럼프 대통령의 군용 선박 건조 협조 요청에 대해 “최대한 적극적으로 협조하겠다”는 확고한 의지를 표명했다. 이어 세계 최고 수준의 함정·선박 제조 역량을 보유한 국내 대표 조선 기업들의 기술력을 트럼프 대통령에게 직접 소개했다.)

President Trump was also reported to have expressed high expectations for South Korea’s overwhelming shipbuilding capacity and rapid procurement speed. Taking the dinner discussions as an opportunity, the two leaders agreed to immediately launch working-level consultations—including a working group involving officials and experts from both countries—to review specific implementation plans for military ship construction. (트럼프 대통령 역시 한국 조선업의 압도적인 건조 능력과 신속한 조달 속도에 큰 기대감을 나타낸 것으로 전해졌다. 양 정상은 이번 만찬 환담을 계기로, 군용 선박 건조의 구체적인 실행 방안을 검토하기 위한 양국 정부 및 전문가 간의 실무 협의(Working Group)를 즉시 이어가기로 합의했다.)

President Lee and President Trump continued their amicable conversation, recalling the promise of a ‘golf meeting’ that had drawn attention during the previous G7 summit. The two leaders agreed to coordinate President Lee’s official schedule for a visit to the United States in the near future. They particularly committed to jointly pursuing a one-on-one golf round with President Trump on the occasion when President Lee’s U.S. visit itinerary is finalized. (이 대통령과 트럼프 대통령은 지난 G7 정상회의 당시 화제를 모았던 ‘골프 회동’ 약속을 상호 상기하며 화기애애한 대화를 이어갔다. 두 정상은 가까운 시일 내에 이 대통령의 공식 미국 방문(방미) 일정을 조율하기로 뜻을 모았다. 특히 이 대통령의 방미 일정이 확정되는 계기에 트럼프 대통령과의 단독 골프 라운딩을 함께 추진하기로 확약했다.)

item.title: President Lee and Zelenskyy hold 43-minute summit (李대통령-젤렌스키 43분간 정상회담)
item.description:
President Lee and Zelenskyy hold 43-minute summit (李대통령-젤렌스키 43분간 정상회담)

President Lee Jae-myung, who visited Ankara, Turkey to attend the NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) summit, held a 43-minute summit with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on the 8th (local time). (나토(NATO·북대서양조약기구) 정상회의 참석차 튀르키예 앙카라를 방문한 이재명 대통령이 8일(현지 시각) 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령과 43분간 정상회담을 했다.)

Although the two leaders had previously exchanged handshakes at last year's G7 summit, this marks the first time their meeting has led to a separate bilateral summit. (두 정상은 지난해 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의에서 만나 악수를 주고받은 적은 있지만, 별도의 정상회담으로 이어진 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Given that President Lee promised comprehensive support worth $100 million (approximately 150 billion won) to Ukraine the previous day, related discussions are expected to take place during this meeting. (전날 이 대통령이 우크라이나에 1억달러(약 1500억원) 규모의 포괄적 지원을 약속한 만큼, 이번 회담에서도 관련 논의가 이뤄질 것으로 보인다.)

Additionally, they are anticipated to exchange views on cooperation measures for an early end to the war in Ukraine and the establishment of peace. (아울러 우크라이나 전쟁의 조기 종전과 평화 정착을 위한 협력 방안에 대해서도 의견을 교환할 것으로 예상된다.)

National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac, in a local briefing the previous day, explained the rationale for the $100 million support, stating, "We have consistently provided support to Ukraine through various channels, including humanitarian aid," and "this expands our contributions as part of that ongoing effort." (위성락 국가안보실장은 전날 현지 브리핑에서 1억달러 지원에 대해 “인도적인 지원을 포함해 다양한 경로로 우크라이나를 꾸준히 지원해 왔다”며 “그 연장선에서 우리의 기여를 확대하는 것”이라고 취지를 설명했다.)
